Expected change site: the Phase 4 review wait in `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`.
Evidence of absence: No hunk touches the Phase 4 review wait. The issue's fix list and affected-files list name only the clarify, plan, implement, alt-model and orchestrate-decompose waits. The changelog says the Phase 4 review wait keeps its generic timeout error. This is a disclosed scope boundary, not a missed deliverable.
SEVERITY: NIT
